title: 46岁做AI语音，月入6万，他说年轻人太嫩
title_en: At 46, Built AI Voice to $60K/Month, Says Young People Are Too Soft
title_jp: 46歳でAI音声を月収6万ドルに、若者は甘すぎると語る
title_ar: في الـ46، بنى AI صوتي لـ60 ألف دولار شهريا، يقول إن الشباب لينون جدا

{"ops": [{"insert": "46岁做AI语音，月入6万，他说年轻人太嫩"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "20年企业营销经验，他用"性能定价"搞定太阳能行业", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Neel Bhattacharya不认为自己在做"AI公司"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他在解决一个20年来一直在琢磨的问题："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么企业会失去他们已经花钱获取的客户？", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "背景是企业营销自动化——IBM Unica、Salesforce、Adobe Campaign。在"营销自动化"成为buzzword之前，他就建了多渠道orchestration系统。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那段时间，他发现一个pattern：在voice + SMS + email中响应最快的公司获胜。不是预算最大的，是最快、最coordinated的响应。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来进入澳大利亚能源行业。太阳能公司每月花5万+美元投Google Ads，生成几百个leads，然后花4+小时才回电话。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "买家选择第一个响应的人。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2023年，AI语音技术终于mature到可以解决这个问题。于是他建了TheSolarAI.com——一个voice + SMS + email orchestration系统，60秒内响应太阳能leads，convert成appointments。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么选择语音？因为2-5万美元的决策需要human conversation。但企业无法24/7 staffing。AI bridging that gap。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在为澳大利亚太阳能行业的enterprise clients服务，并扩展到LeadTrackAI，进入汽车、房地产、家居服务——几乎所有speed + multi-channel follow-up = revenue的行业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "太阳能是wedge。LeadTrackAI是horizontal platform。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月入约8000美元（约6万人民币）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式很有趣——"}, {"insert": "100%基于performance。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "客户预付0美元。只有当leads convert到appointments时，他们才赚commission。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么？20年实施企业平台后，他学到：CFOs买outcomes，不是features。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""What if it doesn't work?"总是他听到的objection，于是他remove了它。不work就不需要pay。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是的，capital-intensive。是的，creates lumpy revenue。但完美地align incentives。他们是partners，不是vendors。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "关键metrics："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "18个月平均客户retention", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "客户conversion rate提升30-90%", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "过去5个月零churn", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Performance pricing创造evangelical customers。比predictable MRR更有价值。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这种定价差点kill business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 upfront 支付AI/SMS/infrastructure成本，然后等30-90天收commission。所以early months，在gain clients、get strong conversions的同时，bleeding cash while waiting for payment cycles。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果重来，可能rethink早期定价，改走hybrid。Pricing创新很好，但需要afford得起你的商业模式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AI容易，workflow难。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "20年建企业营销系统，他知道："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "哪些touchpoints重要（voice → SMS → email）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么时候follow up（60秒、2小时、第二天、3天、1周）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个阶段说什么（qualify → educate → create urgency → close）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MVP是Frankensteining的——用GPT-4、Twilio、VPS、Google Sheets做database（是的，真的）。Ugly，但functional。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三周后，在Brisbane installer放弃的50个"dead" leads上测试。结果：46% contact rate，多个booked appointments，closed deals。他immediately asked to use it。那是validation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花两个月建真正的platform。然后又花六周才拿到first paying customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是在invent技术。只是把20年企业expertise apply到finally caught up的AI capabilities，他知道会work的策略。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "语音AI质量一开始inconsistent。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "会talk over customers、mishear Australian accents（"solar" → "sola"）、fumble objections等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花了四个月fine-tuning conversation flows、accent training、objection libraries。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Customers helped——他们通过分析millions of conversations over years知道"good"听起来什么样。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Reliability scales better than hype。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以stack的motto是："}, {"insert": "Use proven tools; innovate in the application。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是LeadTrackAI（和早期TheSolarAI）运行在deliberately "boring" but powerful stack上的原因。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "OpenAI GPT-4 Turbo做logic", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ElevenLabs做natural voice", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deepgram做real-time transcription", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Twilio做calls和SMS", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Python/FastAPI、PostgreSQL、Redis backend，AWS hosting", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Next.js/React dashboard", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "直接集成Salesforce、HubSpot、Pipedrive", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果：可扩展的voice automation，处理1200+ daily interactions。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为最终，技术是20%的成功——理解workflow是80%。这才是real competitive edge。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么增长的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Leveraged多年的relationships和credibility。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分创始人talk "growth hacks"。他的策略：给认识了15年的人打电话，说："我建了东西，解决我们一直抱怨的问题。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分创始人做不到，因为他们在build industries they discovered last quarter的行业。当你在一个行业worked多年时，your network IS your moat。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Breakdown："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "1. Direct network", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "50个personalized LinkedIn messages给前同事、consultants、conference connections", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "30%的demo → paying clients", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2. LinkedIn content", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Behind-the-scenes building、client wins、industry insights", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Positioned as expert/educator，不是vendor", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "3. Industry events", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "All-Energy Australia、Smart Energy Council events", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "分享frameworks，从不mention product", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What DIDN'T work：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "❌ Google Ads（expensive，wrong audience）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "❌ Facebook Ads（B2B solar不在FB browse SaaS）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "❌ Cold email（low response，felt spammy）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果重来，会做得不同："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sooner hybrid pricing", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Month 3 build leadership team，找right team complement缺乏的", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Day 1 build in public", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "选择熟悉的问题。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最好的产品来自years（不是weeks）obsessing over a problem。所以build你complained多年的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他rant了20年"businesses losing leads to slow responses"，一直在用各种automation suites修复。TheSolarAI不是"pivot"，是years of obsession。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What problem have you experienced for 5+ years that's still unsolved？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And go Enterprise。大部分indie hackers chase SMBs。Understandable——hate enterprise sales。6-8周sales cycles，security reviews，contract negotiations。花在meetings上的时间而不是coding。但enterprise value是10-50x higher。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "九、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Domain expertise compounds。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有：如果你35+，觉得自己"too old"做founder——你不是。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他46岁，这是unfair advantage：20年domain expertise，在一个AI-first founders with zero real-world experience的世界里。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "今天大部分AI founders："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "过去5年从Stanford/MIT毕业", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deeply know ML/AI", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Zero understanding of actual business problems", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们"learn"一个行业6个月，读blog posts，interview 5个人，build chatbot，然后wonder why nobody buys。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他做了opposite。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为domain expertise compounds；technical skills是commodity。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果你35+，你15-20年的domain expertise是younger founders没有的unfair advantage。Use it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Neel的故事是反击年龄歧视最好的例子。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "46岁不是太晚，是just right。20年的积累，让他比年轻创始人更懂业务、更懂客户、更懂workflow。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的核心洞察——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Domain expertise > Technical skills。Reliability > Hype。Outcomes > Features。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有那个大胆的定价策略——performance-based，0预付，conversion后才收费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这需要confidence in your product，也需要cash flow management。但alignment of incentives creates the best customer relationships。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以，如果你35+，有领域 expertise，别觉得自己太晚。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你可能正是AI时代最需要的人。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: Forty six making AI voice sixty thousand monthly he says young people too naive. Twenty years enterprise marketing experience he uses performance pricing to crack solar industry. Neel Bhattacharya does not think he is doing AI company. He is solving problem he has been pondering for twenty years. Why do businesses lose customers they already paid to acquire. Background is enterprise marketing automation IBM UnicasalesforceAdobe Campaign. Before marketing automation became buzzword he built multi channel orchestration system. During that time he discovered pattern in voice plus SMS plus email fastest responding company wins. Not biggest budget fastest most coordinated response. Later entered Australian energy industry. Solar companies spend five thousand plus dollars monthly on Google Ads generating hundreds of leads then take four plus hours to return calls. Buyers choose first responder. Twenty twenty three AI voice technology finally mature enough to solve this problem. So he built TheSolarAI.com voice plus SMS plus email orchestration system responds to solar leads within sixty seconds converts to appointments.
